description: This file contains functions for managing and manipulating the random number generator (RNG) state in PyTorch, including setting, getting, seeding, and forking RNG states across CPU and various devices.

methods.name: set_rng_state
methods.description: Sets the RNG state for the default generator on CPU.

methods.name: get_rng_state
methods.description: Returns the RNG state for the default generator on CPU.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for generating random numbers on all devices and returns a Generator object.

methods.name: _manual_seed_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for setting seeds across multiple devices.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for non-deterministic RNG and returns the seed value.

methods.name: _seed_custom_device
methods.description: Sets the seed for custom devices supporting privateuse1.

methods.name: initial_seed
methods.description: Returns the initial seed for the default RNG on CPU.

methods.name: fork_rng
methods.description: Context manager to fork the RNG state for specified devices, restoring it after.
